a.lede: A new worm-like malware toolkit named SCKit was deployed in the recent ScreenConnect attacks targeting managed service providers (MSPs), designed to spread from infected customer devices to MSP technicians' computers and compromise additional managed networks. [...]
a.title: New worm-like 'SCKit' malware targets MSPs in ScreenConnect attacks

b.lede: ConnectWise is investigating an active malware campaign targeting managed service providers (MSPs) that uses compromised ScreenConnect environments to deploy rogue remote-access clients to customer devices. [...]
b.title: Active ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs, impact dozens of organizations
